findings.note: Two required checks are marked passes:true, but both declared evidence files are explicitly absent from the bundle. The default-fail contract therefore lacks reproducible evidence for required regression and placeholder-scan gates.

After Copy-Payload succeeds and the batch-wide post-copy verification detects corruption, FailedTarget remains null while every target remains in PublishedTargets. The report consequently labels the corrupted target INSTALLED and digest-verified, contradicting the required truthful live-state reporting; the supplied security review confirms this path is untested.
